Definition: perhaps a primary word; a (male) paramour; figuratively, apostate:--adulterer.
BiblicalUsage: Moichos is an adulterer. Paul lists adulterers among those who will not inherit the kingdom of God, Hebrews says marriage is honourable and God will judge adulterers, and the Pharisee in the temple thanks God he is not like other men, extortioners, unjust, adulterers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word stands as a boundary stone. God honours marriage, and He judges what breaks it, and the Pharisee's prayer shows I can be guilty of the same pride while naming the sin in others.
RelatedEvents: The Pharisee and the Tax Collector
